title: Open Mic With Mike @ Tremont Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic hosted by local musician Mike McDade. Bring your instruments or voice and perform covers or originals. Supportive community atmosphere for all experience levels.
event_venue_information:
Tremont Tavern Music Venue

A true neighborhood institution and cornerstone of Chattanooga's live music scene since 2006. Tremont Tavern has established itself as a premier destination for local musicians seeking an intimate and welcoming stage to showcase their talent.

Venue Atmosphere

Known for its laid-back and inclusive vibe the tavern features a small but intimate stage perfect for acoustic performances and full band sets. The decor blends vintage character with modern comfort creating an authentic dive bar experience that music enthusiasts love.

Music Programming

Beyond open mic nights Tremont hosts occasional live shows on Friday and Saturday evenings featuring both local and touring acts. The venue has been instrumental in launching the careers of many area musicians and remains a staple in the local touring circuit.

Food and Drinks

The venue is famous throughout Chattanooga for handcrafted burgers made with proprietary beef blends and a carefully curated selection of local and regional craft beers. Full food and beverage service available during all events.

title: Monday Night Open Mic @ Cherry Street Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring musicians poets and performers. Sign-ups begin at 6 PM with performances from 7-10 PM. Three songs or 15-minute limit per performer.
event_venue_information:
Cherry Street Tavern

A downtown Chattanooga gem that opened in 2021 Cherry Street Tavern has quickly become a beloved community gathering space. The venue masterfully blends British pub aesthetics with modern Chattanooga energy creating an atmosphere that feels both historic and contemporary.

The Music Scene

Live music is the heartbeat of Cherry Street Tavern. The intimate 150-person venue hosts open mic Mondays as well as Tuesday night jams and Wednesday poetry sessions. The venue books diverse talent ranging from local singer-songwriters to regional touring bands. The acoustics are exceptional and the stage sight lines are perfect from any seat in the house.

Atmosphere and Community

The candlelit interior features mismatched vintage furniture and quirky wall art creating a welcoming space for all guests. The staff is known for treating regulars like friends and making first-timers feel at home. A back patio provides additional seating and creates one of downtown's best people-watching spots.

Food and Drinks

The kitchen serves elevated pub fare with standout burgers tots and British-inspired dishes. An impressive cocktail menu and rotating craft beer selection complement the food perfectly. Fair prices and generous pours make it an accessible destination.

title: Monday Night Blues Jam @ Gate 11 Distillery
event_description: Weekly blues jam session hosted by Robin Baker Blues Band and rotating house musicians. Sit in with the band and perform your favorite blues tunes. Excellent for blues and rock musicians.
hosts: Robin Baker Blues Band and Rotating Hosts
backline: Full house band with drums and bass available
event_venue_information:
Gate 11 Distillery

Located within the historic Chattanooga Choo Choo Terminal built in 1909 Gate 11 Distillery is a craft spirits producer with an impressive commitment to live music and community. The distillery combines artisanal spirit production with a vibrant music and social venue.

The Music Venue

The Monday Night Blues Jam is one of Chattanooga's most popular recurring music events. The Robin Baker Blues Band hosts a rotating lineup of local and visiting musicians who sit in to play classic blues standards and improvisations. The atmosphere is collegial and supportive with musicians helping each other and audiences enjoying world-class live entertainment.

Spirits and Distillery

Gate 11 produces small-batch vodka gin rum agave spirits and whiskey using custom-built still systems. The distillery offers daytime tours and tastings allowing visitors to learn about the craft. The cocktail bar features creative house-made mixers and spirit flights.

Venue Amenities

The venue includes both indoor and outdoor bar seating with views of the iconic Choo Choo engine and Glenn Miller Gardens. Multiple levels and spaces allow for intimate conversations or large group gatherings. Tours tastings and cocktails available daily.

title: Open Mic Night @ Songbirds
event_description: Twice-monthly open mic series hosted by James Snider of Fresh Mind. Performances from 7-9 PM with sign-ups beginning at 6 PM. Limited to 10 performers on a first come first serve basis.
backline: Guitar bass amp electronic and acoustic guitars keyboard drum kit
event_venue_information:
Songbirds Foundation and Venue

Songbirds relocated to its new Southside location in April 2024 and has become a premiere music venue and cultural institution in Chattanooga. Built on a mission to share the transformative power of music Songbirds combines an intimate concert hall with a remarkable guitar museum.

The Museum Experience

The venue showcases over 40 rare and vintage guitars on display at all times including two Les Paul Goldtop prototypes and Dolly Parton's Fender Acoustasonic. The collection also features vintage effects pedals amps and music memorabilia. Interactive audio and video exhibits provide education and inspiration.

Live Music Programming

The twice-monthly open mic series features musicians from all genres and skill levels. Songbirds also hosts rock bands alt-metal groups cover bands and student performances. All performances occur in a renowned concert hall with excellent acoustics and professional staging. Happy hour pricing on beer and wine from 6-7 PM encourages community participation.

Educational Mission

Beyond the venue Songbirds Foundation offers guitar lessons songwriting workshops music therapy and the Write to Rock program for youth. All venue proceeds support music education and artist development across the South.

title: WanderJam Open Mic @ Wanderlinger Brewing
event_description: Thursday night open mic with house drum kit provided. Bring cymbals and snare. Music of all genres welcome. Supportive atmosphere for emerging artists.
backline: Drum kit with cymbals and snare available
event_venue_information:
Wanderlinger Brewing Company

Located in historic downtown Chattanooga at the Choo Choo property Wanderlinger Brewing is an independently owned craft brewery that has become a hub for creative expression music and community gathering.

The Brewery

Wanderlinger produces award-winning craft beers including their celebrated Stout of Tune which won a bronze medal at the World Beer Cup 2022. The rotating beer selection includes both house brews and carefully curated guest taps. The kitchen offers scratch-made food by Chef Carolyn featuring items like the house Reuben sandwich and rotating seasonal specials.

Live Music and Events

The venue hosts WanderJam on Thursday nights an open mic format perfect for musicians with house drums available. Monday nights feature open mic comedy hosting local comedians in a casual setting. Tuesday nights are dedicated to poetry and spoken word performances. Wednesday nights feature trivia and Thursday afternoons showcase Bluegrass music. The venue also books regional and national touring bands on weekends.

Community Atmosphere

The space is designed for connection with a welcoming environment that feels like a neighborhood living room. The venue is family-friendly until 9 PM and dog-friendly on patios making it accessible to diverse audiences. Board games and card games are available for entertainment between live performances.

title: Thursday Comedy Open Mic @ JJ's Bohemia
event_description: Weekly comedy open mic at this beloved Chattanooga dive bar and music venue. Free admission. Thursday nights only.
venue_address: 231 East Martin Luther King Boulevard Chattanooga TN 37403
event_venue_information:
JJ's Bohemia

Chattanooga's favorite weird little venue since 2006 JJ's Bohemia is an eclectic music and comedy space that has earned a cult following among artists performers and audiences seeking authentic underground entertainment.

Music Programming

JJ's books an extraordinarily diverse range of live music from rock and punk to hip-hop electronic psychedelic and experimental genres. The venue hosts local bands touring acts and genre-specific shows multiple nights per week. The intimate space with its back patio and artistic vibe creates perfect conditions for discovering new music and emerging artists.

Comedy Scene

Every Wednesday night features free comedy open mic providing local comedians with a stage to test new material and build audiences. The venue has hosted nationally recognized comedians and maintains its commitment to supporting the stand-up comedy community.

The Vibe

A true dive bar in the best sense JJ's features no-frills authenticity with legit character. The walls are covered with local art and music posters. There is a smoke-friendly policy and an incredibly welcoming door policy making it accessible to all regardless of appearance or background. Shows generally start at 10 PM and band load-in is 8-9:30 PM. All band members receive 50 percent off drinks.
